_comment: Minimal curriculum for validating the Sleep action (mc-agent docs/plans/SLEEP_ACTION_PLAN.md) in real training, not just live protocol tests. Deliberately isolated to just a goto task + sleep_search_radius, rather than the full production task mix, so Sleep's own legality/reward signal isn't diluted by mine/craft noise while checking it. SleepSearchRadius is cross-cutting (rlenv.Config.SleepSearchRadius, injected centrally by rlenvadapter.TaskSelector) - it turns ActionSleep on for every episode this pool poses, whatever task Select picks, which here is only ever goto.
